notes.title: New Autumn Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a long time without updates, and many thought there would be no more. Perhaps I expressed myself incorrectly earlier: I meant that there will be no more big updates, but small and medium ones will continue to be released.

Today I'm excited to show you a new update, which also comes with a killer 70% discount starting September 22nd at 10 GMT-7! So, let's get started: 

New Features and Changes

Added a new game mode Custom Mode. In it, you can set:
 • Day and night duration
 • Disable hunger and energy drain
 • Disable weather
 • Enable any available season
 • Cheats are enabled by default in this mode
 • Game difficulty selection is available
•Added a new Research Machine. Now you can obtain blueprints for the parts you •need.
•Added a basket for buying all parts from day and night sellers at once.
•Added all crafting parts  now you can produce absolutely everything available in the game.
•Added a “Reroll Cards”button.
 • You can now reroll bonus cards, with the number of rerolls depending on their rarity.
•Added night brightness settings.
•Added new tutorial markers.
•Added a new Halloween season:
 • The event launches every October (or can be enabled separately in Custom Mode).
 • Weather changes to overcast, with fog instead of rain.
 • NPCs get a Halloween-themed appearance.
 • Pumpkins will appear on the streets: if you set them on fire, you will gain 20% of maximum experience.
•Added an icon in the warehouse over parts if you hired a garbage man.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/c97fafa68faaa5e99e3848f6a57707c4ba553896.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/84ff2c65b59cfeeaeeff9464f8d6e6aa7daac324.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/7a923a9448a1056d0f07072afb09894cd93bf089.png"]

Changes and Reworks

•Increased the price of blueprints.
•Decreased the chance of blueprints appearing in shops.
•Reworked Historical Mode: cheats are no longer available, and difficulty cannot be changed.
•The old shooting range mechanic has returned: residents can now test weapons they purchased. The old system also remains if you place weapons and ammo, regular residents will come and shoot.
•Expanded the winter location.
•During rain, the world is now much brighter.
•Shadows have become a bit darker to balance brightness.
•Changed the bonus card cancel mechanic: if you don’t want to pick a card, you will now receive 25% of maximum experience.
•Fixed and improved winter materials in some locations.
•The character now moves slower while crouching.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/78c681228d9db74eb153f6c77057e39e880c6567.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/f3e6e3dcd67e0470fcc5c16f9dca6a3f4eb48b3c.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/720f09bd05f9c5b01070436eeb711692a4b6c3f0.png"]
Fixes

•Fixed some minor issues.
•Fixed the winter menu.
•Fixed snow footstep sounds for both player and residents.
•Fixed a bug where parts from gifts did not move to the warehouse.
•Fixed an issue with the name of Mr. Daryl.

That’s all for now!
A huge thank you to everyone who is testing this is very important to me 💙 In this update, I tried to implement many of your suggestions.

Don’t forget about the upcoming discount!
There will also be a discount on all my games in one bundle. I look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE V5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's time for a big update! You've been waiting for it for a long time, and this update has added a lot of new things, as well as fixed errors. What was in the update:

Level and perk system:
The perk system will give you the opportunity to get new experiences and the results are completely unpredictable, now it will be even more interesting to play, some bonuses will also be cumulative, the player level is not limited, for each level you will be able to receive 1 of 3 unique bonuses

- Added a level system: now you can get experience for actions and level up.
- For each level, you will be given the opportunity to choose 1 of 3 bonus cards.
- Experience is not given if the actions are performed by a worker.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/8daf6bd8eda502c28b4c0ed1120381336d98b6e4.png

Gaining experience:
- For collecting trash - small and large.
- For collecting collectibles and cassettes.
- For buying parts and blueprints.
- For upgrading buildings.
- For creating parts and ammo.
- For collecting water.
- For building something.
- For buying water and boxes of food.
- For selling weapons and ammo.
- For recycling parts.
- For found scrap metal.
- For servicing weapons.
- For completing training missions.
- For viewing the initial tutorial.

The amount of experience is unique for all types of receipt. Also, the levels are infinite, and you can always get a reward for the level.

List of bonuses:
- Discount on parts.
- Discount on food boxes.
- Discount on water bottles.
- Energy is spent more slowly.
- Food is spent more slowly.
- More experience.
- The chance of a rare rarity card appearing has been increased.
- More energy.
- More food.
- The waiting time for residents has been increased.
- More tips.
- The maximum bet in the casino has been increased.
- The markup in the shooting range has been increased.
- The price for cleaning weapons has been increased.
- The price for repairing weapons has been increased.
- The daytime seller works longer.
- The night seller works longer.
- Carmelita works more.
- The speed of creating ammo will decrease.
- The speed of creating parts is reduced.
- More chances to win at the casino.
- Weapon cleaning speed.
- Weapon repair speed.
- The speed of tightening parts.
- Coffee gives more energy.
- More scrap metal from small trash.
- Increased walking speed.
- Sprint.
- One free hot dog every day.
- Food box gives energy.
- Each day, experience is given in an amount based on the maximum experience.
- Discount on blueprints.
- Higher markup on weapons.
- Receiving money - the amount depends on the rarity of the card.
- Receiving a random part depending on the rarity.

This is a brief description of the bonuses - they will help you get new experience, and each new game will be different from the previous one.

My Info tab:
Now you have access to general information about you and your store, many people can see what parts they have without going to the warehouse

- Added character level display.
- Display of warehouse.
- Display of collected bonuses.
- Display of active bonuses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/0a2d321bc527e80dede74f82379fb6d36ae8edee.png

My Home:
The mayor of the city helped us, because you tried very hard, and the mayor gave you a house so that you would not sleep in the workshop.

- The bed is now in the house, and the game will also start in the house.
- Moved the shelf with collectibles.
- Added a bookshelf that gives +10% to the experience gained.
- Added decor in the house.
- Added lamps in the house.
- Added a computer that collects information, and you can get experience every day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/c39f7675bbfcd620960d6cf9dece913af9d02726.png

Weapon Maintenance:
Now you have the opportunity to repair and clean weapons, residents, times are very difficult, so weapons need care, as soon as you open the service window, residents will come to you with weapons, have time to service them and get money, experience and scrap metal, if you don’t have time, you will lose your reputation

- Added a window for weapon maintenance.
- Added mechanics for breaking parts.
- Added mechanics for dirtying parts.
- Added a new tool - a brush for cleaning parts.
- Added a new tool - a wrench for repairing parts.
- Added generation of broken and dirty weapons.
- Added a call for service.
- Added villagers who need to service weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/7d7b0cb15a992c731627bccbd4faf67128221da8.png

Changed or reworked:
- Reworked the mechanics of the recycler - now scrap metal is given immediately.
- Changed and corrected names and descriptions.
- Added localization.

Statistics system:
Many people wanted to see how many weapons he created or how much money he earned. Now it’s possible, compete with others, and monitor your progress

- Added a new statistics tab, it includes:
- How many food boxes were bought.
- How much money was earned.
- How many parts were screwed.
- How many weapons were serviced.
- How much money was spent.
- How many parts were unscrewed.
- How many parts were bought.
- How much scrap was collected.

- How much food was bought.

- How many weapons were sold.
- How many orders were completed.
- How much experience was collected.
- How many meters have been traveled.
- How many parts have been created.
- How many ammo have been created.
- How many parts have been recycled.
- How much water has been purchased.

Additional mechanics:
- Added a coffee machine at Carmelita's.
- Added several new dreams.
- Added new images for loading screens.
- Added new key settings.
- Added the ability to get drunk.
- Added new points on the compass.
- Added new tutorial tabs.
- Added 16 new parts.
- Added an indicator of new parts in the warehouse.
- Added several new parts in the city.
- Added information for the collector's shelf.
- Added 3 new tracks for the radio.
- Added a notification about the possibility of getting a bonus.
- Tools are now rendered in the foreground and will not get stuck in the wall.
- Added a notification about the fact that the basic part cannot be screwed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/0b9d4d4f80124ae8cab8bca8d533ed149f3184a0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/7302d0d8b03685937e2462b4145858add9ef093e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/bb5d5462a4e07c4f3d8deaef7066704f99942a24.png

Balance:
- Increased time of day and night.
- Food balance.
- Water balance.
- Balanced experience system.
- Balanced prices.
- Balanced number of incoming customers.

New location:
- Added a new location near the supermarket, slightly enlarged. There you can find new parts, as well as scrap metal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43773679/9cde18c7de238e68922012dae5efa62034ac2db9.png

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug with attaching weapons to the workbench after saving.
- Fixed a bug with a large number of people.
- Fixed a bug where the cursor disappeared in the menu.
- Fixed a bug where workers were not paid after sleeping.
- Fixed bugs with scrap received.
- Fixed some bugs in creative mode.
- Fixed bugs with the tutorial.
- Fixed a bug where the mission with water was not saved.
- Fixed a bug where you could build a workbench if there was a box with food or water there.
- Fixed a bug where weapons would not appear on the workbench after saving.
- Fixed a bug where if you remove a silencer from a weapon, the fire effect would remain on the silencer.
- Fixed a bug where there could be multiple workers.

That's all the changes! I hope you enjoy this update. This is not the end - several new improvements are planned for the future. Leave feedback, it is very important to me, as it affects the promotion of the game. Help new players and those who want to buy the game with your advice in the reviews. Thank you all for waiting and testing in the test branch. I am waiting for you in our Discord channel and expect discounts - it will be very soon!

notes.title: What will happen in the next update?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are sharing news about the next update and what is already ready in the test branch.

What's new in the character leveling system:

Added: experience for completing training missions and a sound notification when leveling up.
Experience changes: it is now correctly saved and transferred to the next level.
Experience limit: experience is no longer awarded for actions performed by Workers.
Level changes: the percentage of experience received for leveling up has been increased.
Statistics:

Added:
Tracking earned and spent money.
Tracking collected and spent scrap metal.
Crafted and sold weapons.
Distance traveled and much more.
What is already ready in the test branch:

Character leveling system:

Added: numbers on the progress bar, display of experience, new level animation.
Accrual of experience for actions: cleaning large and small garbage, building, collecting cassettes and collectibles, buying spare parts, water and food, upgrading objects, crafting parts and ammo, collecting water, recycling spare parts, collecting scrap metal, creating weapons, completing orders, buying and searching for blueprints, selling weapons and ammo.
House changes:

Moved the bed and shelf for collectibles, changed the introductory video.
Bug fixes:

Fixed incorrect display of collected scrap metal.
Also completed decoding in the house. Added markers to the computer, house and store, as well as a new window for servicing weapons. These changes are already available in the test branch.

We invite everyone to join our Discord channel and test the new mechanics before the full update is released! Your feedback is very important to us!
